services.title: Garden Maintenance
services.desc: Weekly or monthly lawn cutting, hedge trimming, and border care. Keeps your garden looking sharp year-round without the effort.

services.title: Landscaping & Design
services.desc: New patios, decking, pathways, and planting schemes. We transform tired gardens into outdoor spaces you'll actually use.

services.title: Hedge & Tree Work
services.desc: Professional pruning, shaping, and removal of overgrown hedges and trees. Safe, tidy, and properly disposed of.

services.title: Garden Clearance
services.desc: Clearing overgrown gardens, removing debris, and prepping land for new projects. We handle the heavy lifting so you don't have to.

services.title: Turf Laying & Seeding
services.desc: New lawns from turf or seed, drainage work, and soil preparation. Lush, level grass within weeks.

services.title: Seasonal Work

about_pullquote: We treat every garden like it's our own — that's why customers come back.
about_para_1: Lintz Garden Services has been transforming gardens across Newcastle and the surrounding areas for over 15 years. Founded by a lifelong gardener fed up with cowboys and no-shows, we've built a reputation for turning up on time, doing the job properly, and leaving your garden looking better than you hoped. From routine maintenance to complete landscaping overhauls, we've earned the trust of hundreds of local homeowners.
about_para_2: What sets us apart is straightforward communication, fair pricing, and genuine care for your outdoor space. We listen to what you want, offer honest advice, and get the work done with minimal fuss. Many of our customers have been with us for a decade or more — that's the real measure of our work.
reviews_heading: What Newcastle Gardeners Say About Us

reviews.text: We had a real mess of a garden — weeds everywhere, the lawn was just moss, and the hedges hadn't been touched in years. Lee and his team came in, cleared it all, laid new turf, and tidied up the borders. Took about three days total. Looks completely different now. Brilliant job, fair price, and they cleaned up after themselves. Can't fault them.
reviews.author: David P.

reviews.text: Been using Lintz for garden maintenance for about five years now. Regular cuts, hedge trim in spring and autumn. They're reliable, professional, and they actually care about the work. Never had to chase them for anything. Would recommend without hesitation.
reviews.author: Margaret T.

reviews.text: Needed a patio laid and new planting scheme. Lee came out, listened to what we wanted, gave us options, and did brilliant work. The patio's level, the planting looks thoughtful, and honestly it's transformed how we use the garden. Great bloke, honest pricing.
reviews.author: Simon M.
